prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a huge pale albino crocodile, bone-white and pale pink scales, in a low sprawl seen from a three-quarter side view, the thick tail curved round behind it so the whole crocodile, tail included, is no wider than the grey box and sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides in every cell, clusters of grey barnacles crusted on its back and tail, pink eyes, broad short heavy jaws with yellowed teeth (the snout tip well inside the cell), old scars on the snout, thick splayed legs with claws; heavier and broader than a common crocodile. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its broad toothed jaws and pink eye are readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward low with the broad jaws snapping wide open at the heroes, all four feet on the ground, no taller than half again its idle height; the body a little shorter than in the idle cell, the tail curled up tight behind the hips (not stretched back), the whole crocodile from tail tip to snout well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back low, seen from the side as in the idle cell, the jaws snapped shut, the head pulled back, the tail thrashing, all four feet down, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body: coil or stretch the spine, reach the head, jaws and forelegs far from the body, and let the tail, mane or wings move with the motion. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, water, green scales, dark scales, wings, rearing up, standing upright.
